intent: Reuse the existing Saasuna AI conversation edge for confirmed Battle character reactions without creating a second provider, memory layer, router, or gameplay authority.
acceptance: A confirmed self Battle-card resolution causes at most one AI provider attempt per event fingerprint when the selected Partner is Saasuna.
A valid provider utterance is presentation-only and does not mutate canon, relationship, or gameplay.
Provider unavailable, invalid, or failed falls back to the existing approved fixed Battle utterance.
Other Partners keep their existing approved-source behavior.
Primed reconnect state does not replay already-settled reactions.
doNotChange: Battle rules, legality, state, save, economy, network
Convai secret handling or server transport
